title: FREE REQUEST Seeking pixel artist/animator, musician, developer/scripter for pokemon fangame- title tbd!

posts.author: crowpecker
posts.body:
Engine:
RPG Maker XP (From scratch)
Synopsis:
A largely story-based pokepasta fangame based off of Blue Tears. It starts with Red defeating him in the championship; Blue goes on a journey trying to find Red to exact revenge and beat him. He gradually descends into madness. The game will have slight gameplay aspects like battles, but majority cutscenes and dialogue and visual effects.
Positions/Roles Needed:
We need a lot of people. A pixel artist/animator for sprites and background, a musician that can help compose both peppy and gloomy video game music, a scripter/developer to help create cutscenes and text boxes and arrange the visual aspects/change the background as the game progresses.
My Role(s)/Position(s):
Visual art for cutscenes, writer/dialogue maker, planner.
This is relatively new and we are focusing on the story and trying to put it all together!

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body: If you can make a fan game you can make your own game. You can legally rip off Pokemon's mechanics all you want - Want to create a turn-based RPG with six monster party members and four moves each? Go ahead. What you can't do is use their characters or assets: graphics, music, sound effects, etc.
